changelog:
v2.12.1 - DLS Live Boost NETWORK HOLD

When the match goes LIVE:
- Data Saver switches ON — Android itself cuts background data for every app
- WhatsApp (and the game) stay whitelisted — messages keep trickling in
- Wi-Fi low-latency lock — lower ping on Wi-Fi
- Background apps frozen as before

When you leave the game everything reverts to exactly how it was.
